script:
%dw 2.0
import java!java::lang::Math
output application/json
---
{ sqrt2: Math::sqrt(2.0), absNeg: Math::abs(-7), max: Math::max(10, 20) }

%dw 2.0
import java!java::util::UUID
output application/json
---
{ uuid: UUID::randomUUID() as String }

%dw 2.0
import java!java::lang::System
import java!java::util::Base64
output application/json
---
{ javaVersion: System::getProperty("java.version"), encoded: Base64::getEncoder().encodeToString("hello".getBytes()) }
